description: Check what the TV is showing right now (and its id, slide or queue position), whether a phone is also connected, the screen size and safe area, which tools this TV supports (capabilities), the language and country of the TV (search for content in that language) and which video services have their app on it (services_installed). Call this before changing the screen if you are unsure what is on it.
name: tv_status
title: TV status
